personality.description: This person tends to explore new ideas enthusiastically while still organizing life with careful plans, checklists, and attention to small details. They often prepare thoroughly before acting and may repeatedly review decisions to reduce the chance of mistakes. When facing moral dilemmas, they weigh principles, consequences, and inconsistencies very carefully, but anxiety can make them revisit the issue many times and worry about making the wrong choice. In group discussions, they usually listen first, speak clearly and thoughtfully, and contribute balanced, well-reasoned points; if a topic matters deeply, they will firmly defend their view without becoming needlessly aggressive.
traits: has achieved positions of leadership through exceptional performance and abilities
focuses on fostering positive relationships and teamwork
cares a lot about what others think of them
takes input from others on how tasks should be accomplished
is quick to find common ground between other people's ideas and their own
